```{=html}
<style>
.w074 { max-width: 620px; margin: 0 auto; font-size: 0.9rem; }
.w074 .w074-list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; margin-bottom: 0.75rem; }
.w074 .w074-row {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 6px 8px;
  border: 2px solid var(--bs-border-color, #999); border-radius: 6px;
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff);
}
.w074 .w074-row.w074-right { border-color: #2e7d32; }
.w074 .w074-row.w074-wrong { border-color: #d81e2e; }
.w074 .w074-txt { flex: 1 1 auto; }
.w074 .w074-tf { display: flex; gap: 4px; }
.w074 .w074-tf button {
  padding: 2px 10px; border-radius: 6px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer;
  border: 1.5px solid var(--bs-border-color, #999);
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); color: var(--bs-body-color, #222);
}
.w074 .w074-tf button.w074-on { background: #d81e2e; border-color: #d81e2e; color: #fff; }
.w074 .w074-controls { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.w074 .w074-controls > button {
  padding: 5px 14px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color, #999);
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); color: var(--bs-body-color, #222); cursor: pointer;
}
.w074 .w074-note { font-size: 0.78rem; opacity: 0.7; font-style: italic; }
.w074 .w074-msg { font-weight: 700; min-height: 1.4em; text-align: center; margin-top: 0.5rem; }
.w074 .w074-msg.ok { color: #2e7d32; }
.w074 .w074-msg.bad { color: #d81e2e; }
</style>
<div class="w074 iw" id="w074">
  <div class="w074-list" aria-label="statements to judge"></div>
  <div class="w074-controls">
    <button type="button" class="w074-check iw-check">Check</button>
    <button type="button" class="w074-reset iw-reset">Reset</button>
    <button type="button" class="w074-solution iw-solution">Show solution</button>
    <span class="w074-note">(no fun if you click it right away)</span>
  </div>
  <div class="w074-msg iw-msg" role="status"></div>
</div>
<script>
(function () {
  const root = document.getElementById('w074');
  const list = root.querySelector('.w074-list');
  const msg = root.querySelector('.w074-msg');
  const ITEMS = [
    ['With single sign-on, each service still keeps its own user list and grants privileges on its own.', 'f'],
    ['SSO is what makes Zero Trust’s per-request validation workable: the user enters credentials once per task.', 't'],
    ['Privileged access management provides a single, well-guarded master password that opens every system.', 'f'],
    ['A PAM system logs all accesses and failed login attempts, and can alert a manager when a privileged identity is used in a suspicious way.', 't'],
    ['In Azure, accounts, MFA and conditional access are managed centrally in Microsoft Entra ID rather than in each application.', 't'],
    ['Because PAM monitors the administrators, the strongest available authentication is unnecessary for their accounts.', 'f']
  ];

  function clearMarks() {
    root.querySelectorAll('.w074-row').forEach(r => r.classList.remove('w074-right', 'w074-wrong'));
    msg.textContent = ''; msg.className = 'w074-msg iw-msg';
  }
  function select(row, val) {
    row.dataset.sel = val;
    [...row.querySelectorAll('.w074-tf button')].forEach(b => {
      b.classList.toggle('w074-on', b.dataset.val === val);
      b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', b.dataset.val === val ? 'true' : 'false');
    });
  }
  ITEMS.forEach(it => {
    const row = document.createElement('div');
    row.className = 'w074-row';
    row.dataset.a = it[1];
    row.dataset.sel = '';
    const txt = document.createElement('span');
    txt.className = 'w074-txt';
    txt.textContent = it[0];
    const tf = document.createElement('span');
    tf.className = 'w074-tf';
    [['t', 'True'], ['f', 'False']].forEach(v => {
      const b = document.createElement('button');
      b.type = 'button';
      b.dataset.val = v[0];
      b.textContent = v[1];
      b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'false');
      b.addEventListener('click', () => {
        select(row, row.dataset.sel === v[0] ? '' : v[0]);
        clearMarks();
      });
      tf.appendChild(b);
    });
    row.appendChild(txt); row.appendChild(tf);
    list.appendChild(row);
  });
  root.querySelector('.w074-check').addEventListener('click', () => {
    let right = 0, unanswered = 0;
    root.querySelectorAll('.w074-row').forEach(r => {
      r.classList.remove('w074-right', 'w074-wrong');
      if (!r.dataset.sel) { unanswered++; return; }
      if (r.dataset.sel === r.dataset.a) { r.classList.add('w074-right'); right++; }
      else r.classList.add('w074-wrong');
    });
    if (right === ITEMS.length) { msg.textContent = '✓ All correct — PAM is least privilege applied to the administrators themselves.'; msg.className = 'w074-msg iw-msg ok'; }
    else if (unanswered > 0 && right + unanswered === ITEMS.length) { msg.textContent = 'Keep going — ' + unanswered + ' statement(s) still unanswered.'; msg.className = 'w074-msg iw-msg'; }
    else { msg.textContent = '✗ Not yet — ' + right + ' of ' + ITEMS.length + ' statements are right; rethink the red ones.'; msg.className = 'w074-msg iw-msg bad'; }
  });
  root.querySelector('.w074-reset').addEventListener('click', () => {
    root.querySelectorAll('.w074-row').forEach(r => select(r, ''));
    clearMarks();
  });
  root.querySelector('.w074-solution').addEventListener('click', () => {
    root.querySelectorAll('.w074-row').forEach(r => {
      select(r, r.dataset.a);
      r.classList.remove('w074-wrong'); r.classList.add('w074-right');
    });
    msg.textContent = 'Solution shown — reset to try it yourself.';
    msg.className = 'w074-msg iw-msg ok';
  });
})();
</script>
```
